# GM AI Tools HUB
> Free browser-based tools, calculators, converters, templates and learning pages by Gmd Khan Niazi (Ghulam Mohiuddin Khan Niazi), Lahore, Pakistan. Tools run in the browser and do not upload what you type.

## Main sections
- [Free tools and gadgets](https://gmdkhantoolshub.github.io/tools/): 65 tools, including PDF and image converters, calculators, Pakistan salary tax, zakat, tola, marla, electricity bill, fuel cost and amount in words
- [Unit conversions](https://gmdkhantoolshub.github.io/convert/): marla, kanal, tola, maund, seer and common unit conversions
- [Pakistan salary tax tables](https://gmdkhantoolshub.github.io/salary-tax/): monthly tax by salary for 2026-27
- [Blog and guides](https://gmdkhantoolshub.github.io/blog/): money, careers, Excel and sales operations
- [Free Excel templates](https://gmdkhantoolshub.github.io/free-templates/): attendance, KPI scorecard and monthly budget planner
- [About the author](https://gmdkhantoolshub.github.io/about/)

## Notes
- Calculators give estimates for general information. Rates, tax slabs and prices are entered or checked by the user.
